entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. Order number is 774-B-91.

Okay, I'm pulling up that order now. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not needed anymore. The person I bought it for can't use it. Just tell me how to send it back.

I see. Looking at your order, it was delivered on January 2nd, which was 15 days ago. For the VeloBand Pulse model, our policy is a strict 10-day return window for preference-based returns due to hygiene protocols and device activation.
That's not going to work for me. I haven't had time to look at a shipping box, let alone a return policy. There was an emergency.

I understand the policy can be frustrating, and I'm very sorry to hear there was an emergency. While the 10-day window is usually firm, we do have exceptions for extenuating circumstances. Can you tell me what happened?
My husband was scheduled for a military deployment, and right before he was supposed to leave, my father was rushed to the hospital. It was a whole ordeal that ended with unexpected heart surgery.

Oh, my. I am so sorry to hear that. I hope he is recovering well. Thank you for sharing. A situation involving a hospital stay and surgery absolutely qualifies as an exception. I can override the standard policy for you right now.
Okay. So you can process the return?

Yes. Given the medical emergency and the stress of the deployment, I've been authorized to make a one-time exception and I'm processing a full refund for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label now. Once the item is scanned at the post office, the refund will be released to your original payment method. Does that work for you?
Yes, that's perfect. I appreciate you taking care of that. It's a relief.
Of course. I'm happy I could help resolve this for you. The email is on its way. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your family all the best.
